news.n_ane_avaris: Merchants from the west say the Egyptian king Ahmose has taken the fortress of Avaris and driven the foreign Hyksos kings out of the Delta.
news.n_ane_ahmose_nefertari: They say Queen Ahmose-Nefertari has received the title "God's Wife of Amun" and estates of her own at the temple. A woman with such wealth is rare even in Egypt.
news.n_ane_sharuhen: News has come that the Egyptian army besieged Sharuhen in Canaan for three years and has finally taken it. The last of the Hyksos have fled further north.
news.n_ane_nubia_revolt: They say a revolt broke out in the south, in Nubia, but King Ahmose crushed it and brought the prisoners back to Thebes.
news.n_ane_ahhotep: In Thebes they tell of the queen mother Ahhotep: while the king was on campaign, she rallied the deserters and pacified Upper Egypt. The king ordered her praised on a stela.
news.n_ane_tura: They say white limestone is being cut again at the Tura quarries for the temples. Oxen haul the blocks, driven by captives from Canaan.
news.n_ane_telipinu: Far to the north, in the land of the Hittites, after many murders in the royal family, a decree has supposedly been issued on who inherits the throne and how. Nobody here really knows the details.
news.n_ane_ahmose_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Ahmose, who drove out the Hyksos, has died. His son Amenhotep has taken the throne.
news.n_ane_alabaster_chapel: They say King Amenhotep is building a chapel of white alabaster at Karnak for the barque of Amun.
news.n_ane_mitanni_rise: Merchants from the upper Euphrates tell of the kingdom of Mitanni: its Hurrian kings keep the best charioteers, the maryannu, and demand tribute from cities from Assur to the sea.
news.n_ane_water_clock: They say an Egyptian craftsman named Amenemhat has invented a vessel that lets water out drop by drop to measure the hours of the night. Priests can now know the hour of prayer even without the stars.
news.n_ane_thutmose1: News has come of a new king in Egypt, Thutmose — not the old king's son, they say, but a general married to a princess.
news.n_ane_kerma: They say King Thutmose marched far south beyond the cataracts and sacked the capital of Kush. The body of the Kushite chief was carried home hanging from the prow of the royal barge.
news.n_ane_euphrates_stela: Merchants say the Egyptians have reached the Euphrates itself and marvelled at a river that flows "backwards", from north to south. King Thutmose set up his stela on its bank.
news.n_ane_mycenae_gold: Sailors from Keftiu speak of kings on the mainland across the sea to the west who are buried in deep shaft graves with golden masks on their faces.
news.n_ane_ineni: In Thebes people whisper that the architect Ineni cut the king's tomb in the cliffs, "with no one seeing and no one hearing".
news.n_ane_thutmose2: News has come that King Thutmose of Egypt has died. His son, also called Thutmose, has taken the throne; he is married to his half-sister Hatshepsut.
news.n_ane_kush_revolt2: They say Kush has risen again, and the Egyptian army has marched south once more. The children of Kushite chiefs are being taken to Thebes to be raised at court.
news.n_ane_thutmose3_child: News has come that the Egyptian king has died young. The heir Thutmose is still a child, and the land is ruled by the widowed queen Hatshepsut.
news.n_ane_hatshepsut_king: They say Queen Hatshepsut of Egypt has declared herself pharaoh and wears the royal beard. Merchants argue over what to call her now.
news.n_ane_punt: Merchants from the west say the Egyptian queen's ships have come back from the land of Punt with live incense trees in baskets.
news.n_ane_sealand: They say the Kassites have conquered the Sealand in the south. Now all the land from the mountains to the sea obeys Babylon.
news.n_ane_senenmut: They say the queen's steward Senenmut is building a terraced temple against the Theban cliffs, "Holiest of Holies". Wicked tongues whisper that he is too close to the queen.
news.n_ane_obelisks: News has come that two obelisks of Queen Hatshepsut, sheathed in electrum, have been raised at Karnak. On a sunny day it hurts to look at them.
news.n_ane_hatshepsut_dies: News has come that Hatshepsut, the queen who ruled as pharaoh of Egypt, has died. Thutmose III now rules, and they say he is already gathering an army for the north.
news.n_ane_megiddo: Merchants from Canaan say the Egyptian king Thutmose routed an alliance of princes at Megiddo and took the city after a long siege.
news.n_ane_assur_tribute: They say the king of Assur has sent lapis lazuli and chariot teams to the Egyptian pharaoh — to keep on good terms with the new master of Canaan.
news.n_ane_botanical: They say the Egyptian king brought back strange plants and animals from Syria and had them carved on the walls of a temple at Karnak.
news.n_ane_knossos: Sailors say that on the island of Keftiu newcomers from the mainland are now in charge, and the old palaces stand burnt.
news.n_ane_babylon_gifts: News has come that the Babylonian king has sent lapis lazuli and gifts to Pharaoh Thutmose. The Egyptians recorded it in their annals as "tribute".
news.n_ane_euphrates_boats: They say the Egyptians carried boats in pieces on ox-carts across Syria and crossed the Euphrates right into the lands of Mitanni.
news.n_ane_elephants: People say the Egyptian king hunted a herd of elephants in Syria, and his soldier Amenemheb cut off the trunk of an elephant that charged the king.
news.n_ane_mitanni_assur: They say Saushtatar, king of Mitanni, plundered Assur and carried off its temple doors, plated with gold and silver.
news.n_ane_keftiu_envoys: They say envoys from the island of Keftiu have come to Thebes in bright kilts, carrying vessels shaped like bulls' heads.
news.n_ane_thutmose_last: News has come that the ageing King Thutmose III has made his last campaign to the north. They say it was his seventeenth.
news.n_ane_rekhmire: They say the Egyptian vizier Rekhmire hears petitions every morning, and even a poor man can approach him — if the scribes don't chase him off.
news.n_ane_thutmose3_dies: News has come that Thutmose III has died after more than fifty years on the throne. His son Amenhotep, they say, is the strongest archer in Egypt.
news.n_ane_amenhotep2_archer: People say the new Egyptian king shoots arrows through copper targets a palm thick at full gallop, and no one else can draw his bow.
news.n_ane_amenhotep2_captives: They say the Egyptian king has returned from Canaan with a huge crowd of captives. The scribes supposedly counted tens of thousands — probably an exaggeration.
news.n_ane_karaindash: They say the Kassite king Karaindash has built a temple to the goddess Inanna at Uruk with walls of moulded brick: gods of mountains and rivers seem to step right out of the wall.
news.n_ane_kikkuli: Grooms say that among the Hittites a horse trainer from Mitanni named Kikkuli has written down how to train chariot horses over many weeks — when to feed, when to run and when to bathe them.
news.n_ane_assur_gold: They say the king of Assur received twenty talents of gold from Pharaoh. Ever since, Assur has dreamed of Egyptian gold.
news.n_ane_mitanni_bride: News has come that Egypt and Mitanni have made peace, and the Egyptian king Thutmose IV has married the daughter of the king of Mitanni.
news.n_ane_sphinx_dream: People say the Sphinx appeared in a dream to a young Egyptian prince and promised him the throne if he cleared away the sand. Now, as king, he has set up a stela between its paws.
news.n_ane_amenhotep3_king: News has come of a new king in Egypt, Amenhotep III, still very young. They say his treasury holds gold "like dust".
news.n_ane_tiye: They say the Egyptian king has sent out scarabs announcing his marriage: the great queen Tiye is the daughter of a mere chariot officer, Yuya. Imagine that.
news.n_ane_dur_kurigalzu: They say the Kassite king Kurigalzu is building a new city and a ziggurat higher than any in the land.
news.n_ane_lion_hunts: Merchants are showing an Egyptian scarab with an inscription: the king killed one hundred and two lions with his own hands in ten years.
news.n_ane_gilukhepa: News has come that the Mitannian princess Gilukhepa has arrived in Egypt with a retinue of more than three hundred women.
news.n_ane_tiye_lake: They say the Egyptian king had a whole lake dug for Queen Tiye in two weeks, so she could go boating.
news.n_ane_malkata: They say a palace of the Egyptian king has risen on the west bank of Thebes — painted ceilings, birds and fish on the floors and a harbour of its own.
news.n_ane_kadashman_sister: They say the Babylonian king Kadashman-Enlil complains to Pharaoh in a letter: his sister was sent to Egypt and no one has seen her since — is she even alive?
news.n_ane_colossi: They say two stone statues as tall as ten men have been set up before the Egyptian king's memorial temple.
news.n_ane_soleb: They say the Egyptian king has built a temple far away in Nubia, where he is worshipped as a living god.
news.n_ane_ashur_uballit: News has come of a new king in Assur, Ashur-uballit. They say he no longer intends to bow to Mitanni.
news.n_ane_jubilee: They say the Egyptian king Amenhotep is celebrating thirty years on the throne; envoys from all over the world have come to the feasts.
news.n_ane_burnaburiash_king: News has come that Burna-Buriash has become king in Babylon. They say he wrote to Pharaoh straight away — about gold.
news.n_ane_tadukhipa: They say the Mitannian king Tushratta has sent his daughter Tadukhipa to Egypt with a magnificent dowry.
news.n_ane_ishtar_statue: They say the Mitannian king has sent the statue of Ishtar of Nineveh to the ailing Egyptian king to heal him.
news.n_ane_amenhotep3_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Amenhotep III has died. His son, also called Amenhotep, has taken the throne.
news.n_ane_suppiluliuma: They say Suppiluliuma has become king in the land of the Hittites — a warrior feared by his neighbours from the sea to the Euphrates.
news.n_ane_tushratta_gold: Merchants are laughing: the Mitannian king expected statues of solid gold from Pharaoh but got wooden ones that are merely gilded. Now he sends letter after letter.
news.n_ane_akhenaten_name: They say the Egyptian king has changed his name from Amenhotep, "Amun is content", to Akhenaten, "Effective for the Aten".
news.n_ane_akhetaten_founded: News has come that the Egyptian king is building a new capital for the sun disc, the Aten, on empty ground in the desert on the east bank.
news.n_ane_burnaburiash_daughter: They say the Babylonian king's daughter has been betrothed in Egypt. The list of her dowry fills several tablets.
news.n_ane_nefertiti: They say the Egyptian queen Nefertiti is shown at full height beside the king — even smiting enemies, like a pharaoh.
news.n_ane_amun_erased: They say the temples of Amun are being closed in Egypt and his name chiselled off the walls. Only one god remains — the sun disc.
news.n_ane_tribute_feast: They say there was a great reception of tribute at the new Egyptian capital: envoys came from Nubia, Punt, Canaan, the islands and Mesopotamia.
news.n_ane_mitanni_falls: News has come that the Hittite king Suppiluliuma has taken and sacked the capital of Mitanni. The great kingdom has crumbled.
news.n_ane_rib_hadda: They say the ruler of Byblos sends Pharaoh letter after letter: send archers or the city will fall. Still no answer comes.
news.n_ane_akhenaten_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Akhenaten has died. Nobody knows what will become of his sun god now.
news.n_ane_two_rulers: They say two rulers have come and gone on the Egyptian throne in a couple of years. Who they were, every city tells differently.
news.n_ane_kara_hardash: Merchants from the east say that the young king of Babylon, grandson of the Assyrian king, has been murdered, and the Assyrians have already marched to avenge him.
news.n_ane_restoration: They say the temples of the old gods have been reopened in Egypt, and the young king has changed his name to Tutankhamun.
news.n_ane_ashur_uballit_dies: News has come that the Assyrian king Ashur-uballit has died, under whom Assur became a great kingdom.
news.n_ane_tut_dies: News has come that the very young Egyptian king Tutankhamun has died without an heir.
news.n_ane_zannanza: They say the widow of the Egyptian king asked the Hittite king to send her one of his sons as a husband. The prince set out — and died on the way. The Hittites blame the Egyptians.
news.n_ane_horemheb_king: News has come that the general Horemheb has taken the Egyptian throne.
news.n_ane_hittite_plague: They say there is plague in the land of the Hittites: King Suppiluliuma himself has died, and then his heir. The Hittites say Egyptian prisoners brought the sickness.
news.n_ane_sugagu: News has come that the Assyrians and Babylonians clashed in battle at Sugagu and moved the border once again.
news.n_ane_kurigalzu_elam: They say the Babylonian king Kurigalzu defeated the Elamites and reached Susa.
news.n_ane_eclipse: Merchants from the north say that in the land of the Hittites the sun went dark in the middle of the day as the king set out on campaign. Diviners argue whether it was a good sign.
news.n_ane_horemheb_edict: They say the Egyptian king Horemheb has issued a strict edict against greedy tax collectors and corrupt judges.
news.n_ane_nazi_maruttash: News has come that Nazi-Maruttash has become king in Babylon.
news.n_ane_adad_nirari: They say the new Assyrian king Adad-nirari calls himself "king of the universe" and is already at war in the west.
news.n_ane_shang_anyang: Far to the east, in a land almost unknown here, a king is said to have moved his capital to a new city where people tell the future from cracks in bones and turtle shells.
news.n_ane_ramesses1: News has come that the Egyptian king Horemheb has died without sons. The old general Ramesses has taken the throne.
news.n_ane_seti1: News has come that Seti, son of Ramesses, has become king in Egypt. They say he means to win back everything lost under Akhenaten.
news.n_ane_hypostyle: They say a hall of columns has been begun at Karnak, with columns thicker than a poor man's house.
news.n_ane_seti_campaign: Merchants from Canaan say the Egyptian king Seti marched as far as Kadesh and took back the coastal cities.
news.n_ane_abydos: They say the Egyptian king Seti is building a temple at Abydos with a wall listing all the former kings — except those who are to be forgotten.
news.n_ane_nazi_maruttash_war: News has come that the Assyrian king Adad-nirari has defeated the Babylonian king Nazi-Maruttash, and the border has moved south again.
news.n_ane_ramesses2_king: News has come of a new king in Egypt: the young Ramesses, son of Seti. They say he already went on campaigns with his father.
news.n_ane_pi_ramesses: They say the Egyptian king Ramesses is building a new capital in the Delta, Pi-Ramesses.
news.n_ane_kadesh: Merchants from the west tell of the battle of Kadesh: the Egyptians proclaim victory, the Hittites theirs. The city, at any rate, stayed Hittite.
news.n_ane_shalmaneser: News has come that Shalmaneser has become king in Assur. They say he is building forts all across the west.
news.n_ane_urhi_teshub: They say that among the Hittites an uncle has overthrown the young king, and the young man fled — guess where? — to Egypt, to Pharaoh.
news.n_ane_ramesseum: They say a temple is being built at Thebes for King Ramesses with a granite colossus heavier than any ever seen.
news.n_ane_abu_simbel: They say a temple is being cut into a cliff in Nubia, fronted by four enormous seated figures of Ramesses.
news.n_ane_hanigalbat: News has come that the Assyrian king Shalmaneser has finally crushed Hanigalbat and deported its people.
news.n_ane_hittite_babylon_letter: They say the Hittite king writes to the Babylonian king: your merchants were killed in my lands? Send the families of the dead and I will punish the guilty.
news.n_ane_treaty: News has come that Egypt and the land of the Hittites have made eternal peace. The treaty, they say, is inscribed on a silver tablet.
news.n_ane_nefertari: They say Nefertari, the beloved wife of the Egyptian king Ramesses, has died. The finest painters are decorating her tomb.
news.n_ane_kalhu: They say the Assyrian king Shalmaneser is building a new city on the Tigris, Kalhu.
news.n_ane_khaemwaset: They say the Egyptian prince Khaemwaset, high priest of Ptah, is restoring the ancient pyramids and carving their builders' names on them.
news.n_ane_hittite_bride: News has come that the Hittite king's daughter has arrived in Egypt as Ramesses' wife. Her dowry took a whole caravan to carry.
news.n_ane_tukulti_king: News has come that Tukulti-Ninurta has become king in Assur. They say he is ambitious as no one before him.
news.n_ane_wilusa: Merchants from the Hittite lands say that on the western coast across the sea, people from Ahhiyawa are fighting over the city of Wilusa. No one knows the details.
news.n_ane_nihriya: News has come that the Assyrians have defeated the Hittites at Nihriya. The Hittites are no longer masters of the Euphrates.
news.n_ane_kar_tukulti: They say the Assyrian king is building himself a new city across the Tigris and has named it after himself: Kar-Tukulti-Ninurta.
news.n_ane_ramesses_jubilees: They say the Egyptian king Ramesses is celebrating yet another jubilee. He has reigned so long that people have lost count.
news.n_ane_assyria_babylon_war: News has come that war has broken out again between Assyria and Babylon. Merchants are holding back their caravans.
news.n_ane_babylon_sacked: Merchants from the east say the Assyrian king has taken Babylon and carried off the statue of Marduk.
news.n_ane_adad_shuma_usur: They say the Babylonians have driven out the Assyrian governors and set a king of their own on the throne.
news.n_ane_ramesses_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Ramesses has died after reigning sixty-six years.
news.n_ane_hatti_grain: They say there is famine among the Hittites, and the Egyptian king Merneptah has sent them ships of grain "to keep the land of Hatti alive".
news.n_ane_israel_stela: They say the Egyptian king Merneptah defeated the Libyans and the Sea Peoples and had his victory recorded on a stela: "Canaan is plundered… Israel is laid waste, its seed is no more."
news.n_ane_tukulti_dies: Merchants from the east say the Assyrian king Tukulti-Ninurta has been killed by his own son and nobles.
news.n_ane_amenmesse: They say there is turmoil in Egypt: a king of its own, Amenmesse, has appeared in Thebes, while another rules in the north.
news.n_ane_wu_ding: Far to the east, say merchants who heard it from other merchants, there rules a king whose wife leads armies herself. Who knows if it's true.
news.n_ane_bay: They say the powerful chancellor Bay, a Syrian by birth who made and unmade kings, has been executed in Egypt.
news.n_ane_mycenae_fires: Sailors say that across the sea to the west the palaces of the Achaean kings are burning, and nobody knows who is setting them alight.
news.n_ane_tausret: News has come that Egypt is ruled by a woman pharaoh again — Queen Tausret.
news.n_ane_alashiya: They say the king of Ugarit is writing to the king of Alashiya: enemy ships are burning my towns, and my army is far away in the land of the Hittites.
news.n_ane_setnakht: News has come that Setnakht has become king in Egypt and, they say, restored order after the turmoil.
news.n_ane_ugarit: News has come that the rich port of Ugarit has been burned. They say nothing is left but ruins.
news.n_ane_melishipak: They say the Babylonian king Meli-Shipak is generous with grants of land and sets up boundary stones cursing anyone who moves the border.
news.n_ane_hattusa: They say the Hittite capital Hattusa has been abandoned and burned. The great kingdom of the Hittites is no more.
news.n_ane_ashur_dan: News has come that Ashur-dan has become king in Assur.
news.n_ane_sea_peoples: They say the Egyptians have beaten back an invasion of the Sea Peoples at the mouths of the Nile.
news.n_ane_libyans_r3: They say the Egyptian king Ramesses III has again defeated the Libyans who tried to settle in the Delta.
news.n_ane_punt_r3: They say the Egyptian king has again sent ships to Punt for incense, and others to the copper mines in the desert.
news.n_ane_medinet_habu: They say the temple of Ramesses III on the west bank of Thebes is finished, with the battle against the Sea Peoples carved on its walls.
news.n_ane_elam_raid: News has come that the king of Elam has ravaged Babylonia and taken the stela of Hammurabi to Susa.
news.n_ane_strike: They say the royal tomb workers at Thebes have downed tools and are sitting by the temples: their rations are not being paid.
news.n_ane_kassite_end: News has come that the Elamites have deposed the last Kassite king of Babylon.
news.n_ane_harem_plot: They say a plot against the king himself has been uncovered in Egypt's royal household of women.
news.n_ane_ramesses4: News has come that Ramesses IV has become king in Egypt. Huge gifts from the late king have been sent to the temples — the lists fill a long scroll.
news.n_ane_isin2: They say a new dynasty from the city of Isin has risen in Babylonia and is fighting the Elamites.
news.n_ane_hammamat: They say the Egyptian king sent eight thousand men to the desert quarries of Wadi Hammamat for statue stone. Many did not come back.
news.n_ane_ramesses5: They say the Egyptian king Ramesses V died young of a sickness that covered his body with sores.
news.n_ane_canaan_left: They say the Egyptian garrisons have left Canaan and the copper mines in the desert. Egypt no longer holds lands in the north.
news.n_ane_ashur_dan_dies: News has come that the Assyrian king Ashur-dan has died after reigning almost half a century.
news.n_ane_ramesses9: News has come that Ramesses IX has become king in Egypt.
news.n_ane_nebuchadnezzar_king: News has come that Nebuchadnezzar has become king in Babylon. They say he has sworn to bring back the statue of Marduk from Elam.
news.n_ane_desert_raiders: They say Libyans from the desert are raiding the west bank at Thebes, and the tomb workers sit idle for days.
news.n_ane_amenhotep_hpa: They say the Egyptian king has rewarded Amenhotep, high priest of Amun, who had himself depicted on a temple wall as tall as the king himself.
news.n_ane_tiglath_king: News has come that Tiglath-Pileser has become king in Assur. They say he is a hunter and warrior such as has not been seen for a long time.
news.n_ane_tomb_trials: They say robbers of royal tombs are on trial at Thebes, and the mayors are accusing each other.
news.n_ane_nebuchadnezzar_marduk: News has come that the Babylonian king Nebuchadnezzar has defeated Elam and brought back the statue of Marduk.
news.n_ane_tiglath_sea: They say the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser reached the Great Sea, cut cedars in Lebanon and sailed out on a ship from Arvad.
news.n_ane_ramesses11: News has come that Ramesses XI has become king in Egypt.
news.n_ane_tiglath_babylon: News has come that the Assyrians have burst into Babylonia and burned the palaces in Babylon and Dur-Kurigalzu.
news.n_ane_hpa_siege: They say the high priest of Amun has been besieged in his temple at Thebes, and Nubian troops are lording it over the city.
news.n_ane_hyenas: They say there is famine at Thebes; people call it "the year of the hyenas".
news.n_ane_panehsy: They say the Nubian viceroy Panehsy is at war with the Theban priests, and Upper Egypt lies ruined.
news.n_ane_famine_mes: Merchants from the east tell of a terrible famine in Assyria and Babylonia and of Aramean nomads on every road.
news.n_ane_renaissance: They say a new era has been proclaimed at Thebes, the "Repeating of Births", and the priest-general Herihor now rules there.
news.n_ane_tiglath_dies: News has come that the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser has died.
news.n_ane_wenamun: People say that the Egyptian envoy Wenamun, who came to Byblos for cedar for the barque of Amun, was laughed at there: Egypt frightens no one any more.
news.n_ane_ashur_bel_kala: News has come that Ashur-bel-kala has become king in Assur.
news.n_ane_crocodile: They say the king of Egypt has sent the Assyrian king strange gifts: a crocodile and a large ape.
news.n_ane_ramesses11_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Ramesses XI has died. Smendes rules the north from Tanis, and the priests of Amun the south. Egypt is divided.
news.n_ane_adad_apla_iddina: They say an outsider, an Aramean, has seized the Babylonian throne: Adad-apla-iddina.
news.n_ane_esagil_kin_apli: They say the Babylonian scholar Esagil-kin-apli has gathered all the signs of disease into one book — from head to foot — so physicians will not make mistakes.
news.n_ane_pinedjem: They say Pinedjem, the high priest of Amun at Thebes, has taken royal titles. The priests are rewrapping the mummies of ancient kings plundered by thieves.
news.n_ane_zhou: Far to the east, say merchants who heard it from other merchants, one kingdom has crushed another in a great battle, and a new house now rules there.
news.n_ane_arameans_babylon: They say the Arameans and Sutians are plundering Babylonia so badly that even the New Year festival of Marduk is no longer held.
news.n_ane_ahmose_pyramid: They say the Egyptian king Ahmose is building himself a pyramid at Abydos, like the kings of old.
news.n_ane_kush_viceroy: They say the Egyptian "King's Son of Kush", the viceroy of the south, sends barges of Nubian gold to Thebes every year.
news.n_ane_coregency: They say the old Egyptian king Thutmose has made his son Amenhotep his co-ruler.
news.n_ane_ugarit_script: Merchants from Ugarit boast that their scribes write on clay with just thirty signs instead of hundreds, as here.
news.n_ane_kurigalzu_refusal: They say the princes of Canaan invited the Babylonian king Kurigalzu to join them against Egypt, and he refused: "I am in alliance with Pharaoh."
news.n_ane_tukulti_epic: They say a long poem has been composed in Assur about how King Tukulti-Ninurta defeated the treacherous Babylonian king.
news.n_ane_siptah: They say the Egyptian throne has gone to young Siptah, who has a lame foot, while the queen and the chancellor rule for him.
news.n_ane_shutruk: They say a warlike king, Shutruk-Nakhunte, rules in Elam and is eyeing Babylonia.
news.n_ane_ramesses4_dies: News has come that the Egyptian king Ramesses IV has died after only a few years on the throne.
news.n_ane_ramesses7: They say grain prices in Egypt have risen so high that a sack of barley costs as much as an ox. King Ramesses VII can do nothing about it.
news.n_ane_ashur_resha_ishi: News has come that Ashur-resha-ishi has become king in Assur. They say he is at war with Babylon again.
news.n_ane_babylon_temples: They say the new Babylonian king, outsider though he is, is rebuilding the temples and the city walls.
news.n_ane_assur_famine: They say there is famine in Assyria, and the Arameans are closing in on Assur itself.
